headline: Mercury EV-Tech appoints Shreyan Patel as additional director
summary: Mercury EV-Tech has announced the appointment of Shreyan Patel as an additional director on its board. The company operates in the electric vehicle sector, making board-level changes relevant to its corporate governance and operational strategy. Retail investors in the small-cap stock should monitor how new leadership impacts the firm's growth execution in the EV space.
why_it_matters: Routine board appointment with negligible immediate impact on stock price.

headline: Mercury Ev-Tech announces changes to its board of directors

headline: Mercury Ev-Tech submits AGM scrutinizer report and voting results
hook: AGM voting results now on record
summary: Mercury Ev-Tech Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results from its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange.
